description: Defines classes and methods for managing asynchronous task scheduling for user equipment (UE) within the CU-CP system, including ue_task_scheduler_impl and ue_task_scheduler_manager.

classes.name: ue_task_scheduler_impl
classes.description: Async FIFO task scheduler for a single UE managed by the CU-CP.

classes.name: ue_task_scheduler_manager
classes.description: Service class to manage UE task schedulers and handle async task dispatching.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for a UE, returning true if successfully enqueued.

methods.name: create_timer
methods.description: Creates a timer for the UE.

methods.name: get_timer_factory
methods.description: Returns the timer factory associated with the scheduler.

methods.name: get_executor
methods.description: Returns the task executor used by the scheduler.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the UE task scheduler and discards pending tasks.

methods.name: create_ue_task_sched
methods.description: Creates a new UE-specific task scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_async_task
methods.description: Handles an asynchronous task for a specific UE.

methods.name: clear_pending_tasks
methods.description: Clears pending tasks for a specific UE.

methods.name: dispatch_and_await_task_completion
methods.description: Dispatches a task and waits for its completion, with overload for different task types.

methods.name: rem_ue_task_loop
methods.description: Removes a UE task loop from the manager.
